ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.4 Tail Cleanup
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-D.2.4 for RimWorld 1.5. Keeps the D.2.3 self-conflict cleanup, gates T34-B speculative prefetch by measured candidate yield, and identifies the first Unity cleanup from the exact Game.LoadGame/InitNewGame boundary so one following redundant cleanup can be skipped. Proven job-search filters, reservation/reachability transactions, T34-D worker validation, and retired WaitProbe save migration remain active.
